args: const [name,root,retention,...files]=process.argv.slice(1); if(!process.env.ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN||!process.env.ACTIONS_RESULTS_URL)throw new Error("GitHub Actions artifact runtime credentials are required"); const location=process.env.FLUENTCI_GH_ARTIFACT_CLIENT; const sdk=location?await import(location):await import("@actions/artifact"); const client=new sdk.DefaultArtifactClient(); const result=await client.uploadArtifact(name,files,root,{retentionDays:Number(retention)}); console.log(JSON.stringify(result));

name: gitlab-artifacts
title: GitLab artifacts
notes: Use setup-gitlab-artifacts to install glab and Bun. upload accepts a prebuilt ZIP and the running job ID; CI_JOB_TOKEN is read only at execution time. apiUrl supports self-hosted GitLab. GitLab runner artifact permissions and job lifecycle apply. For standard GitLab pipelines, native artifacts: declarations remain preferable when no explicit upload step is needed. download fetches the named job artifact for a ref; glab uses its native login or GITLAB_TOKEN.

commands.name: upload
args: const [archive,jobId,baseUrl]=process.argv.slice(1); const token=process.env.CI_JOB_TOKEN; if(!token)throw new Error("CI_JOB_TOKEN is required for job artifact upload"); const form=new FormData();form.append("file",Bun.file(archive),archive.split("/").pop());const response=await fetch(baseUrl.replace(/\/$/,"")+"/jobs/"+encodeURIComponent(jobId)+"/artifacts?artifact_format=zip&artifact_type=archive",{method:"POST",headers:{"JOB-TOKEN":token},body:form});if(!response.ok)throw new Error("GitLab artifact upload failed: HTTP "+response.status);console.log(JSON.stringify({jobId,status:response.status,body:await response.text()}));

title: SonarQube
notes: Install SonarScanner CLI and the Java runtime required by that release, or use its bundled runtime. Supply SONAR_TOKEN and optionally SONAR_HOST_URL through the environment. Configure sonar-project.properties or typed fields. properties contains nonsecret property=value entries; values become literal -Dproperty=value arguments. qualityGateWait=true waits for the server quality gate and fails when it fails. Analysis sends project information to the configured SonarQube service.

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Analyze the configured project and submit results to SonarQube.

name: sqlfluff
title: SQLFluff
notes: Use setup-sqlfluff or supply sqlfluff on PATH. lint is read-only and preserves the native failing exit status; fix writes project files explicitly. Select the project dialect in configuration or arguments. dbt and other optional templater dependencies must be installed in the same Python environment; the default installer provides core SQLFluff. Reports can be retained through writeOutput and artifacts.

name: sqruff
title: Sqruff
notes: Use setup-sqruff or supply sqruff on PATH. lint preserves native failures and does not change SQL files; fix explicitly writes changes. Select a dialect in arguments or .sqruff configuration. JSON/SARIF diagnostics are available in execution logs; GitLab Code Quality output can be written with writeOutput. Configuration and templater libraries are trusted project inputs.

name: syft
title: Syft
notes: Install Syft. Directory sources can use dir:.; image sources may require a container daemon or registry access. output accepts repeated format or format=path values, such as cyclonedx-json=sbom.json. SBOM generation inventories packages; it does not apply a vulnerability policy. Use Grype or Trivy to check the resulting SBOM.

name: tangled-artifacts
title: Tangled release artifacts
notes: Install tangled-release-asset-uploader or use setup-tangled-artifacts. This purpose-built uploader is separate from aly.codes/tg. The annotated tag must already be pushed to the repository. username must own that repository; provide its app password through TNGL_UPLOADER_APP_PASSWORD. Passwords are never module inputs or task arguments. Files are checked locally before upload. The uploader prints each created AT URI in task stdout; the execution report preserves it for downstream steps.

commands.name: upload
commands.description: Upload files as assets attached to an existing annotated Tangled tag.

name: terraform
title: Terraform
notes: Plan uses ordinary exit codes. The raw run export treats every nonzero status as a failure, including detailed-exitcode=2.

name: terragrunt
title: Terragrunt
notes: Requires Terragrunt with the redesigned run command and an installed OpenTofu or Terraform engine. Commands target one unit; use run.arguments for --all and other advanced operations.

name: trivy
title: Trivy
notes: Install Trivy. Named scans enforce --exit-code=1 and default to HIGH,CRITICAL severity. Native database/check downloads occur unless disabled with the corresponding flags; offlineScan alone does not supply a vulnerability database. Image scans use native registry credentials. Choose scanners explicitly to control filesystem/image coverage. Findings, including secret scan output, may contain sensitive data.

commands.name: sbom
commands.description: Scan an existing SBOM for vulnerabilities.

name: trufflehog
title: TruffleHog
notes: Install a current TruffleHog 3 CLI supporting --fail-on-scan-errors. Named scans disable updates and credential verification, and fail on results or scan errors. Remote Git repositories still require network access and authentication. TruffleHog JSON output may contain raw detected values; protect task logs and reports. The generic run export permits other native modes, including verification if explicitly requested in arguments.

commands.description: Scan a Git repository without credential verification.

name: ubicloud
title: Ubicloud
notes: Ubicloud is a thin client: commands and help are defined by its API server. Set UBI_TOKEN; optionally set UBI_URL. All ubi invocations, including help, contact that server. Use run.arguments for the command advertised by your server; unsupported endpoints are not guessed.

name: uv
title: uv
notes: Install uv before invocation. Python interpreters may be downloaded by uv when needed. sync and run_command can create or update .venv; locked and frozen control lockfile handling. publish reads UV_PUBLISH_TOKEN or UV_PUBLISH_USERNAME/UV_PUBLISH_PASSWORD, or native index authentication. Use a configured index for private registries; keep credentials out of JSON.

name: vault
title: Vault
notes: Install vault and configure VAULT_ADDR and VAULT_TOKEN or the native token helper. kv_metadata requires KV v2; mount selects the engine mount. kv_put takes a dataFile path, not plaintext JSON values. KV operations execute immediately under the existing token policy. Secret paths and task output are persisted, so protect the run directory. Use run for agent configurations or other native operations, and avoid commands that print tokens or plaintext secrets.

name: vercel
title: Vercel
notes: Install Vercel CLI and authenticate with vercel login before invoking. VERCEL_TOKEN alone is not forwarded as --token. For CI, provide an executable wrapper that reads the token from its environment and invokes vercel with --token; use executable to select it. VERCEL_ORG_ID and VERCEL_PROJECT_ID can select a project.

name: wrangler

notes: Install setup-wrangler or provide Wrangler on PATH. Supply CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID through the CI environment. dry_run bundles locally; deploy and pages_deploy publish immediately. versions_upload creates a version without switching traffic. Pages deployment requires an existing Pages project. Use Wrangler 3.73+ for the stable Workers versions commands.
